transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I’ve been forgetting things at work… scheduled callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I told people I’d do. It’s gotten pretty bad, honestly. They sent me here because it’s starting to affect my chances of moving up.
When did you first notice you were having trouble remembering things?

I guess I really noticed it about 11 months ago. That’s when the new management company came in and switched us to digital work orders and stricter documentation. Since then it’s been… harder to keep up.
Are you also forgetting things outside of work?
Mostly it’s the work stuff I notice. The callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I said I’d do… that’s what’s been piling up and got me sent here.
Have you been experiencing any unusual stress or anxiety, especially around the time your memory problems started?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say anything unusual. Work’s been more stressful with the changes, I guess, but I haven’t really thought of it as anxiety.
Are you having trouble remembering things in your personal life, like appointments or birthdays?

Not really birthdays or things like that… at least, that’s not what’s gotten bad. It’s more the scheduled callbacks and work orders, follow-ups I told people I’d handle. That’s what’s piled up enough that work sent me here.
Are you having any difficulty remembering how to perform routine tasks or chores at home?
No… I don’t think so. Chores are just chores. I haven’t noticed forgetting how to do them or anything like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to concentrate or make decisions?

Yeah… concentration, I guess. I’ll start a digital work order thinking I’m following it, then halfway through the notes my mind’s already gone to some other noise or the next job. Then I realize I don’t really know what I just read.
Have you had any head injuries or been in an accident recently?
No… nothing like that recently. I haven’t had any accidents or hit my head that I can think of.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?
Not really… I mean, I get frustrated, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been sad or depressed.
Do you ever feel confused or disoriented?
Not really disoriented, no. I mean, I can lose track of what I’m doing, but I know where I am and all that.
Have you had trouble learning new things, like new procedures or tasks, since your memory problems started?
I’m not sure… I haven’t really noticed it that way. New stuff can take me a bit, but I don’t know if that’s different than before.
Do you ever find yourself struggling to find the right words when you're talking to someone?
I don’t think so… I mean, sometimes I pause, but I haven’t really noticed trouble finding words.
Do you have trouble paying attention to things for a long period of time?

Yeah… I do. Like with the work orders on the tablet, I’ll start reading the notes and think I’m following it, then halfway through my mind’s already gone to some other noise or the next job. Then I realize I don’t really know what I just read.
Do you have trouble understanding what people are saying to you?
Sometimes, yeah. If my supervisor is talking right to me about a repair or an audit, I’ll be looking at him, but only the first part really stays. Then I have to ask him to say it again.
Do you have trouble remembering things you've learned or been told after a short period of time?

Yeah… that’s actually been a big problem. I’ll be told about a callback or a work order, or I’ll tell somebody I’ll follow up, and then not long after it’s just… gone. It’s happened enough that it’s backed up on me at work, and they sent me here because of it.
Have you experienced any other health problems or medical conditions around the same time your memory issues started?
Not that I can think of. I mean… I haven’t noticed anything else starting around then.
Do you think your memory problems are related to your overall mental state or mood?
I don’t know. I haven’t really connected it to my mood or anything like that. It just kind of happens.
Are you having any difficulty managing your daily life outside of work due to your memory problems?

Mostly it’s work stuff, honestly. Callbacks, work orders, little follow-ups I said I’d do… I keep forgetting them, and it’s gotten piled up enough that they sent me here. I’m worried it’s going to mess up my chance at moving up if I don’t get it under control.
Are your memory problems causing you significant difficulties in your personal life?

I don’t think so… not significantly. It’s mostly been the work stuff that’s been noticeable. At home, I mean, I forget little things sometimes, but I haven’t really thought of it as a big personal-life problem.
Are your memory problems causing any difficulties in your relationships with family or friends?
Not really, no. I mean, nobody’s really said anything to me about it. I haven’t noticed it causing problems with family or friends.
